#  11160 - Dependable Distributed and Wireless Systems Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11160 - Phase-out Module**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Dependable Distributed and Wireless Systems**  |  
|  Zuverlässige verteilte und drahtlose Systeme   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. Langendörfer, Peter 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 6 semesters  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Participants will become familiar with state-of-the-art technologies that serve design and operation of dependable distributed and wireless hardware / software systems.  |  
| Contents:  | The module consists of several tutorials , composed according to demand and availability, list of courses is available and updated (see attachment to programme of studies).  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Diploma / Master in computer science, computer engineering or electrical engineering.  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Tutorial / 20 Hours 
  * Seminar / 20 Hours 
  * Self organised studies / 140 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Students get web-access to available materials from all related courses.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Oral examination, 30 min. **OR**
  * Presentation and interview covering a set of tutorials, 60 min.

The actual form of the examination will be anounced at the beginning of the course.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Structural Doctoral Programme / Dependable Systems / PO 2012 

 |  
| Remarks:  | Module content can be composed according to available tutorials.  |  
| Module Components:  | Block tutorials offered within the PhD net programme of studies, list is published and updated.
  * _Dependable Distributed Systems_ , B. Schnor, Universität Potsdam
  * _Self-Stabilizing Distributed Systems_ , B. Schnor, Universität Potsdam
  * _Asynchronous System Design_ , NN, Leibniz-Institut IHP für innovative Mikroelektronik, Frankfurt (Oder)
  * _Security in Wireless Systems_ , P. Langendörfer, Brandenburgische Technische Universität Cottbus & Leibniz-Institut IHP für innovative Mikroelektronik, Frankfurt (Oder)

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 18.01.2022 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
